question: What transition is made after explaining the ābhāsa mansion type?
premises: The ābhāsa mansion has already been declared.
A new topic called vikalpa is introduced.
The hearer is instructed to listen now.
inference: Having declared the ābhāsa mansion, the teaching now turns to its variant forms.
plain_english: The ābhāsa mansion has been explained; now listen to its variant.
